motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: --ease. The mark's bracket slide-in and the scroll reveal.

motion.name: mark-settle
motion.purpose: The mark's square scaling into place between the brackets (home hero only).

motion.name: mark-brackets
motion.purpose: Brackets slide in 80px from each side (home hero only).

motion.name: mark-halo
motion.purpose: One halo expands from the square to 3.2x and fades, once.

motion.name: night-breathe
motion.purpose: The night light breathes: opacity 0.85 to 1, scale 1 to 1.05.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Sections fade in on scroll, opacity only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on links and buttons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Turns off every animation above; the halo is hidden and reveals show immediately.

breakpoints.purpose: max-width. Nav collapses to a toggle with a night-2 drop panel.

breakpoints.name: layout
breakpoints.purpose: max-width. Splits, intros, voice, close, ruled, ladder and steps go to one column; sections drop from 96px to 64px.

narrative.northStar: One clear signal held between two lines.
narrative.overview:
The mark is two brackets holding a single square. Everything in the system follows from it: the brackets are the structure (night bands, ruled lines, plain grotesk type), and the square is the one signal (indigo, used for actions, markers, and the thing that matters on each page).

Every page has the same three movements. It opens in **night** (#0d0e14) with one soft indigo light, the header, and the page's opening. The **day** middle is paper (#f3f5f7) and white bands separated by hairline rules, where the content is read. It closes in **night** again with a conversational call and the legal line. The middle never has atmosphere; the bookends never hold dense content.

The design's voice matches the copy: senior, technical, calm. No slogans set large, no decorative effects, one authored animation.
keyCharacteristics: The middle never has atmosphere; the bookends never hold dense content.
No slogans set large, no decorative effects, one authored animation.
Hierarchy comes from size and weight, with tight negative tracking on large sizes. Numerals are tabular.

rules.name: One signal rule
rules.body: No second accent. If something needs to stand out, it gets weight, a rule, or the signal colour, never a new hue.

rules.name: No kicker rule
rules.body: Nothing small and uppercase sits above a heading.

dos: **Do** open and close every page in night, and keep content in the day middle.
**Do** give the signal colour one job per element: action, marker, or highlight.
**Do** give every link and button a 44px target.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour, gradients on content, or coloured side borders.
**Don't** set slogans large. Headlines state facts about the work.
**Don't** add effects that are not the mark's own motion.
